parlays.name: Value 2
parlays.why: The main pick: two legs from different games, each worth its price on its own where a real price is known. Two legs keep the bookmaker's margin small (about 9% at standard prices against about 24% for six).

legs.story: Jake LaRavia over on points: he is in the starting group and plays heavy minutes; he has tended to play well against the Hawks; a close game should keep the starters on the floor late.

legs.note: market main line, blended halfway with the market
legs.story: Cavaliers to cover: the Cavaliers have been the clearly better team this season; the Hornets are without Brandon Miller and Dennis Schroder. The gap between the two rosters is wide enough to expect more than a narrow win.

parlays.story: Built around Jake LaRavia's steady role and the Cavaliers against a Hornets side without Brandon Miller and Dennis Schroder. Every leg comes from a different game, so one surprise result cannot sink two legs at once.

parlays.name: The daily 6
parlays.why: The long shot: six legs, at most two per game. It pays big but lands rarely, and the bookmaker's margin compounds over six legs, so it needs every leg to carry real value. Treat it as the optional extra, not the main bet.
